kind: fixed V6/V7 ample action parity, actual-prefix fallback mechanism and local fill latency
diagnosticRepair: First helper failed after4 complete games/80 parity states because it incorrectly required fill to mutate work.owner. Production fill intentionally uses an overlay and leaves its input unchanged. Failed source/classes/intent/log and repair manifest are preserved and pinned under failed-overlay-assumption. This helper verifies all serialized input fields unchanged and independently applies emitted placements through core. No candidate, corpus, actions, evaluation games or selection changed; no first completed result existed.
selection: All40 existing V6 boss replays, all first20 recorded states; fixed70 underpaint prefixes from prior diagnostic
armOrder: V6 then V7 at even(slotIndex+turn), otherwise V7 then V6
history: Both bots observe the recorded public boards. Their feature recordTarget is reset to the actual accepted target after each turn. Per-state shared RNG seed isolates parity; neither server RNG nor interrupted execution history is reconstructed
fillMechanism: Invoke actual private V7 fill on accepted own prefix via reflection with constant-zero clock, startNs0, budgetNs60000000000; prefix/target are fixed. Validate complete command with Rules.expand; income via Rules.updateConnections/Rules.incomePerTurn outside fill
fillTiming: After all parity/mechanism checks, one fixed500ms warmup on the first tallest retained underpaint prefix. Each of70 fixed prefixes then invokes real-clock V7 fill once with ample60000ms budget. Timed interval includes reflection invocation but excludes bot init, copying, clock setup, validation, income and report work
candidateRule: The exact production V7 method is measured; earning membership is frozen at accepted prefix, not recomputed during fill. No hypothetical opponent actions influence rank
limitations: Reused boss states are development diagnostics, not independent strength evidence.
Ample action parity does not prove timed V6/V7 decisions will match.
Direct fill invocation tests legal prefix completion, not whether CG actually aborts at a particular phase.
Immediate hypothetical own/net income omits simultaneous opponent actions and future survival; extra paint is not a win guarantee.
Single-process warmed wall timings include reflection overhead and do not reconstruct CodinGame CPU/JIT/scheduling/parsing.
The ample60000ms diagnostic does not enforce the production turn deadline; zero-clock and real-clock selected fills must agree.
